{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:thunderkit:continuity:v1",
  "title": "Thunderkit model-free continuity v1",
  "$comment": "No settings object carries authority. Runtime decoding additionally enforces UTF-8 byte/depth/duplicate-key bounds, exact identity/index/path bindings and merged numeric cross-field limits. Paths are literal POSIX paths; filesystem safety is checked separately. Integer tokens must be JSON integers, not bool or floating-point spellings.",
  "oneOf": [
    {"$ref": "#/$defs/policy"},
    {"$ref": "#/$defs/project-settings"},
    {"$ref": "#/$defs/global-settings"},
    {"$ref": "#/$defs/context-pointer"}
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "token": {
      "type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 128,
      "pattern": "^(?![\\s\\S]*\\.\\.)[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}(?![\\s\\S])"
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 4096,
      "pattern": "^(?!//)(?![\\s\\S]*(?:^|/)\\.\\.(?:/|$))[^\\\\:\u0000-\u001f\u007f-\u009f\\ud800-\\udfff]+(?![\\s\\S])"
    },
    "absolute-path": {
      "allOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/path"}, {"pattern": "^/"}]
    },
    "identity": {
      "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["kind", "id"],
      "properties": {
        "kind": {"enum": ["project", "global"]}, "id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/token"}
      }
    },
    "project-identity": {
      "allOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/identity"}, {"properties": {"kind": {"const": "project"}}}]
    },
    "global-identity": {
      "allOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/identity"}, {"properties": {"kind": {"const": "global"}}}]
    },
    "locator": {
      "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["identity", "path"],
      "properties": {"identity": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identity"}, "path": {"$ref": "#/$defs/path"}}
    },
    "policy": {
      "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["schema"],
      "properties": {
        "schema": {"type": "integer", "const": 1},
        "backup": {
          "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
          "properties": {
            "enabled": {"type": "boolean"},
            "interval_minutes": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 10080, "default": 15},
            "retention": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 10000, "default": 20},
            "prune": {"type": "boolean", "default": false},
            "limits": {
              "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
              "properties": {
                "max_file_bytes": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 1073741824, "default": 10485760},
                "max_snapshot_bytes": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 10737418240, "default": 104857600},
                "max_files": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 100000, "default": 10000},
                "max_path_bytes": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 4096, "default": 4096},
                "max_sources": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 10000, "default": 1000}
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "restore": {
          "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
          "properties": {
            "max_context_bytes": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 16777216, "default": 65536}
          }
        },
        "git": {
          "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
          "properties": {"push_after_commit": {"type": "boolean", "default": true}}
        }
      }
    },
    "project-entry": {
      "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["identity", "project_root"],
      "properties": {
        "identity": {"$ref": "#/$defs/project-identity"},
        "project_root": {"$ref": "#/$defs/absolute-path"},
        "backup_root": {"$ref": "#/$defs/absolute-path"},
        "latest_context": {"$ref": "#/$defs/locator"}
      }
    },
    "project-settings": {
      "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["schema", "kind", "identity", "project_root"],
      "properties": {
        "schema": {"type": "integer", "const": 1}, "kind": {"const": "project-settings"},
        "identity": {"$ref": "#/$defs/project-identity"},
        "project_root": {"$ref": "#/$defs/absolute-path"},
        "backup_root": {"$ref": "#/$defs/absolute-path"},
        "latest_context": {"$ref": "#/$defs/locator"}
      }
    },
    "global-entry": {
      "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["identity"],
      "properties": {
        "identity": {"$ref": "#/$defs/global-identity"},
        "backup_root": {"$ref": "#/$defs/absolute-path"},
        "latest_context": {"$ref": "#/$defs/locator"},
        "approved_sources": {
          "type": "array", "maxItems": 10000, "uniqueItems": true,
          "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/absolute-path"}
        }
      }
    },
    "global-settings": {
      "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["schema", "kind"],
      "properties": {
        "schema": {"type": "integer", "const": 1}, "kind": {"const": "global-settings"},
        "policy": {"$ref": "#/$defs/policy"}, "global": {"$ref": "#/$defs/global-entry"},
        "projects": {
          "type": "object", "maxProperties": 10000,
          "propertyNames": {"$ref": "#/$defs/token"},
          "additionalProperties": {"$ref": "#/$defs/project-entry"}
        }
      }
    },
    "context-pointer": {
      "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["schema", "kind", "identity", "path"],
      "properties": {
        "schema": {"type": "integer", "const": 1}, "kind": {"const": "context-pointer"},
        "identity": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identity"}, "path": {"$ref": "#/$defs/path"}
      }
    }
  }
}
